observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an outdoor lawn at a country club or golf course with trees and water in the background
observation.dancers: one man and one woman, mixed couple
observation.formation_and_space: partners moving around each other, chasing, circling, and advancing/retreating across an open grassy area
observation.posture: upright torso, soft knees, weight shifts dynamically between feet
observation.footwork: fast stepping and skipping patterns on the beat, quick changes of weight, cannot see precise toe/heel mechanics due to distance and grass

observation.hips_and_torso: minimal isolated hip movements; torso remains upright with upper body sways and turns
observation.partnering: frequent close and open partnering, holding hands, holding opposite ends of a red scarf, lifts, and playful chases with no continuous closed ballroom hold

observation.costume_and_props: female wears a white ruffled dress with colorful floral decorations and orange flowers in her hair, barefoot; male wears a white shirt, dark trousers, belt, red scarf around neck, white handkerchief at waist, and a straw hat; props include straw hats and a long red scarf

male kneels on the grass holding one end of a red scarf while female skips and circles around him holding the other end
